item.text:
Implemented the landing-page updates:

- `Start free` is the sole filled hero CTA; `See how it works` is outlined.
- Filled CTA keeps white text on hover/focus with a visible focus ring.
- Hides Resources navigation on phones.
- Reorders assurances to place “Works with your stack” before “Cancel anytime.”
- Proof cards stack responsively at phone widths, preventing horizontal overflow.

Verified with `npm test` and `git diff --check`.

The transcript did not include the highlighted review-note headline text, so the existing headline was retained.
